data.name: Horrific Visage
data.description: You can draw upon your hag ancestor to cause one target to perceive you as having a horrifying appearance. As a standard action, you can force one target within 30 feet to make a Will save (DC %1) or be shaken for %2 rounds. This is a mind-affecting, fear-based ability. This fear does not stack with other fear effects. You may use this ability %3 times per day.|Sorcerer_AccursedHorrificVisage_DC|Sorcerer_AccursedHorrificVisage_Duration|Sorcerer_Accursed_BloodlinePower1Times
